name: population-city
title: City Population Annual Timeseries (UN Statistics Division)
description: Population of cities by year, for both sexes and for females and males, from the UN Statistics Division (UNSD Demographic Statistics, table: City population by sex, city and city type). Each data file comes with a file of the footnotes it refers to.

licenses.name: ODC-PDDL-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License v1.0. Applies only to the maintainers' own work (the update script, the column definitions and the file layout). It does not replace the UN data conditions of use; see README.md and ATTRIBUTION.txt.

licenses.name: UNdata-conditions-of-use
licenses.title: UN data conditions of use. They apply to the figures and footnotes in the files in data/. All data may be copied, duplicated and further distributed free of charge, provided UN data is cited as the reference.

sources.name: UN data
sources.title: UN data: UNSD Demographic Statistics, City population by sex, city and city type (table 240)

resources.name: unsd-citypopulation-year-both
resources.description: City population for both sexes, one row per figure.

fields.name: Country or Area
fields.description: Country or area, as named by the UN.

fields.name: Year
fields.description: Reference year of the figure.

fields.name: Area
fields.description: Part of the city covered, for example Total.

fields.name: Sex
fields.description: Both Sexes in the first file; Female or Male in the second.

fields.name: City
fields.description: City name, as given by the UN (often in capitals).

fields.name: City type
fields.description: City proper or Urban agglomeration.

fields.name: Record Type
fields.description: Kind of record, for example Estimate - de jure or Census - de facto - complete tabulation.

fields.name: Reliability
fields.description: Reliability of the figure, for example Final figure, complete or Provisional figure.

fields.name: Source Year
fields.description: Year of the source the figure was taken from.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: Population. A few figures have a decimal part.

fields.name: Value Footnotes
fields.description: Footnote numbers for this figure, separated by commas (for example 4,5); empty when there is none. The numbers are explained in the footnotes file that goes with the data file.

resources.name: unsd-citypopulation-year-both-footnotes
resources.description: Footnotes for the figures in unsd-citypopulation-year-both.csv.

fields.name: footnoteSeqID
fields.description: Footnote number, as used in the Value Footnotes column of the matching data file.

fields.name: Footnote
fields.description: Text of the footnote.
